description: This line plot illustrates the performance of five different trajectory prediction methods—TrajiCL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64—as a function of a varying "Ratio" parameter, with performance measured by the minimum average displacement error (minADE₂₀) in meters. The x-axis, labeled "Ratio," spans from 0 to 1.0 in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis, labeled "minADE₂₀ (m)," ranges from 0.60 to 0.75 in a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The "TrajiCL" method is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 0.61 and remaining relatively flat near 0.60. The "Head Tuning" method is shown as an orange line with triangle markers, beginning at approximately 0.78 and steadily decreasing to about 0.69. The "FT" method is depicted as a green line with square markers, starting at approximately 0.68 and declining sharply to around 0.58. The "LoRA 16" method is represented by a red line with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 0.73 and decreasing to about 0.61. The "LoRA 64" method is shown as a purple line with pentagon markers, starting at approximately 0.73 and decreasing to about 0.61. All lines show a general downward trend as the Ratio increases, with the "FT" method consistently performing worse than the others, while "TrajiCL" shows the most stable performance.
